name: access.py
summary: Data, walks and rules: fake data, snapshot/live loaders, lookups, graph walks, 29 rule checks (24-28 on table activity, 29 Streamlit app exposure), Activity views (activity, query_sql, app_exposure, app_use, warehouse_use), what_if, diff. No Streamlit import.

name: server.py
summary: FastAPI JSON API over access.py (make_app) and serve()/serve_csv() reused by st_react.py; PAGES, ROUTES, host/origin checks.

name: cache.py
summary: config() FAKE/SOURCE/ACCESS_SNAPSHOT, name() cache keys, get() / store() / swap(): memory + .cache/*.pkl with .prev.pkl under per-key locks; the parts store (.cache/reads/<key>/*.parquet, parted()) so a stopped load resumes; sql_copy() DuckDB copy written in a thread (COPYING).

name: sf.py
summary: Snowflake connection (key pair or SSO, app session inside Snowflake) and rows(): every read goes through it, each statement limited by STATEMENT_TIMEOUT (limit, none for a CALL).

name: app.py
summary: Streamlit page: sets server.BACKGROUND = False (a refresh runs on the script thread with the app's session) and server.LOG_LINES = True, hides Streamlit chrome, shows a "component did not load" hint, runs st_react.app.

name: st_react.py
summary: React app (web/dist-st) as one Streamlit component; answer() routes its API calls to server.py; shown() runs a load in a thread and writes its progress lines into a box.

name: ui.py
summary: Presentation constants sent in /api/meta: TOKENS, node styles, PCLASS, TYPE_ICON, HELP, psort.

name: run.py
summary: Launcher: web (server.py) or streamlit (app.py), --fake, --direct/--objects, --port.

name: run_sql.py
summary: Runs the '-- name:' statements of a sql/ file with &NAME filled from settings.local.sql; a name it lacks keeps the settings.sql value. check_names stops on unfilled <NAME>, quotes, $ or backslash in STREAMLIT_APP / QUERY_TAG, and STATEMENT_TIMEOUT / WORKERS / ACTIVITY that are not whole numbers (run_sql.py:29-31); every statement but a CALL carries STATEMENT_TIMEOUT (run_sql.py:71-76).

name: docs/make_readme.py
summary: Fills generated parts of README.html between <!--map:NAME--> markers (overview, flow, rules).

name: test_access.py
summary: Walker / rule / cache / live / perf tests on fake data; reruns itself with ROLE_PREFIXES=ZF_,ZT_.

name: test_server.py
summary: Every endpoint on fake data via FastAPI TestClient; read-only, same-site, bundles fresh, Streamlit bridge.

name: test_sql.py
summary: Worksheet SQL of sql/1_setup.sql (table functions, findings procedure) against access.py on DuckDB.

name: web/src/App.tsx
summary: React shell: URL routing (?page=, redirect of old links), side nav, top bar Find, data panel, VIEWS map page -> component.

name: web/src/main.tsx
summary: Local SPA entry (npm run build -> web/dist).

name: web/src/st/main.tsx
summary: Streamlit entry (npm run build:st -> web/dist-st): API calls become component requests answered by st_react.py.

name: web/src/st/protocol.ts
summary: Streamlit component protocol: componentReady, setComponentValue, setFrameHeight, onRender.

name: web/src/api/client.ts

name: web/src/api/types.ts

name: web/src/ctx.tsx

summary: /api/activity: object TBL_CUSTOMER (findings [24], DDL row, graph, sensitive people, no mark, work 7-19, query_sql, objects meta), user ENGINEER_01 (24, 27), role SYSADMIN (graph None, gone row), SALES.CORE -> scope, WH_SALES_XS -> warehouse, ST_CUSTOMER_LOOKUP -> app (SUPPORT_01 saw VW_CUSTOMER, no graph), /api/who app exposure, untagged TBL_ORDER SET TAG text, as= narrows; rules 24-28 in area Activity

name: test_activity
summary: SP_ACCESS_SNAPSHOT activity step on DuckDB: same SELECT text as access.activity_sql; the body runs with &QUERY_TAG / &STREAMLIT_APP replaced by a.QUERY_TAG / a.APP_ST (test_sql.py:318-319), same ACTIVITY_DAYS, QUERY_TAG and APP_ST; no ACCESS_HISTORY -> UNAVAILABLE with the reason, no rows for the run; ACTIVITY in DATA. name: AppNote
summary: Banner on a Streamlit app's Who has access page: viewers see the owner role's data, who can open it, sensitive data the owner reads, people who see it but can't read it; link to the Activity tab

name: AppViewers
summary: Streamlit app view: tiles (opened, can open never did, saw data they can't read, opened without access now) and a table of who can open it and who did

name: Warehouse
summary: Warehouse view: users who ran queries on it (QUERY_HISTORY usage read) and who can use it but did not

name: OffHours
summary: People (or objects) with queries at weekends or outside the business hours, with the objects they touched

name: Touched
summary: Who touched what: heat grid of one dimension down and another across (or days), last 30 days or the window, all or off-hours, all or sensitive objects

name: Hours
summary: Queries by hour of day per user or object, business hours shaded; business-time slider UTC-12..+14 shifts the UTC hours

name: Detail
summary: Objects busiest first with search and sensitive filter, then the picked object: ObjTiles, ByClient, Kinds, Matrix, ByType

name: WhoUsed
summary: One row per user, role and client: statements, queries, off-hours, days active

name: QuerySql
summary: Copy-only SQL of every query behind the tab (query_sql); the app never runs it

name: page_sql
summary: page_sql(page, p, first=None, last=None) -> [dict(title, sql)]: the read-only SQL to run yourself behind a page, most useful first. show=activity: warehouse -> QUERY_HISTORY by warehouse + 5_object_users; else activity_once_sql (every section from one base read), one activity_section_sql per section + query_sql. Else user -> 2_user_access, 1_user_roles; role -> 3_role_access, 4_role_holders; object -> 5_object_users + tags and policies; usage -> objects used; sensitive/flow/review/home -> sensitive tags; rules/home/whatif/review/fallback -> PUBLIC grants, admin holders, dormant/disabled users. Never run.

name: activity_section_sql
summary: activity_section_sql(name, what, first, last, key, work=WORK_HOURS) -> dict(title, sql): SQL behind one Activity section: plain() with SET <var>, FROM_DAY, TO_DAY (+ WORK_START, WORK_END, TZ_HOURS=0 for hours / off) over ACT_BASE filtered by ACT_FILTER[what] plus the SELECT of ACT_SECTIONS[key].

name: query_file
summary: query_file(file, title, **sets) -> dict(title, sql) or None: reads access_queries/<file> and rewrites each SET <k> = ...; line with lit(v); None when the file is missing (an old deploy).

name: plain
summary: plain(title, about, sets, body) -> dict(title, sql): comment lines, NEEDS (privileges), SET lines from lit(), then the SELECT using $NAME.

name: lit
summary: lit(v): SQL literal for a SET line: None -> NULL, bool -> TRUE/FALSE, int as is, else single-quoted with quotes doubled.

name: ACT_SECTIONS
summary: Activity section key -> (title, what it shows, final SELECT on X): tiles, client, kinds, matrix, type_day, by_day, hours, off, touched, objects, who, ddl.

name: ACT_BASE
summary: CTEs A (ACCESS_HISTORY in $FROM_DAY..$TO_DAY), H (one row per object READ / WRITE / DDL), X (+ QUERY_HISTORY role, type, StreamlitName; SESSIONS client) with a {where} filter.

name: ACT_FILTER
summary: what -> (SET variable, filter on X): object OBJECT_NAME, user USER_NAME, role ROLE_NAME, app APP_NAME, scope IN_SCOPE (LIKE prefix).

name: OFF
summary: Off-hours test in SQL: ISO weekday > 5, or local hour (UTC + $TZ_HOURS) outside [$WORK_START, $WORK_END).

name: NEEDS
summary: Comment block on every plain() query: read-only; needs IMPORTED PRIVILEGES on SNOWFLAKE or SECURITY_VIEWER / GOVERNANCE_VIEWER; ACCOUNT_USAGE lags up to 3 hours.

name: QUERIES
summary: Path of the access_queries folder next to access.py, read by query_file.

name: DAYS_USAGE
summary: 30: days of QUERY_HISTORY in the warehouse query of page_sql (comment: the snapshot's DAYS).

name: sql_page
summary: GET /api/sql: {page, queries} = a.page_sql(page or 'home', p) with None entries dropped; ROUTES['sql'], not in WITH_REFS.

name: SqlBox
summary: One query in a <pre> with an optional title and a Copy SQL button (copyText; Copied or Select and copy).

name: SqlPanel
summary: SQL behind this page dialog: useApi('sql', {...params, page}), Escape or Close hides it, one SqlBox per query; says the app never runs them.

name: SectionSql
summary: React context: Activity section key -> SQL (ActivityPage.section_sql), provided by Activity.

name: Sec
summary: Section card of the Activity log; its sql key reads SectionSql and adds a SQL toggle button that shows a SqlBox above the body.

name: test_tag_settings
summary: QUERY_TAG="it's", STREAMLIT_APP=ST_OTHER in a child process: a.QUERY_TAG / a.APP_ST take them, activity_sql writes <> 'it''s' and NOT LIKE '%.ST_OTHER%' (quote doubled, cannot end the string)

name: csv_on
summary: True unless env CSV is 0: CSV export on; read by serve_csv and meta

name: Pager
summary: Prev / Next under a long list with 'Rows a-b of N' and an optional per-page pick; used by DataTable and the Activity busiest-objects table

name: CsvOn
summary: React context, default true: CSV export on; App provides meta.csv

name: useCsv
summary: Reads CsvOn; every CSV button checks it

name: test_csv_off
summary: CSV=0: meta.csv false and every server.CSV route answers 403 csv_off, through FastAPI and st_react.answer; on by default

name: pager.test.tsx
summary: Vitest: DataTable pages 120 rows by 50, Next, a filter resets to one page, CSV button hidden under CsvOn false

name: store
summary: (d, now) kept as key's data: memory, the .pkl (keep_prev first) and the SQL copy in a COPYING thread run in a copy of the caller's context (its lines reach the load log); a read without an OK run (RUN_ID None) stays in memory only.

name: swap
summary: A refresh read under key new becomes key's data, under lock(key): new's parts folder replaces key's, then store().

name: parts_dir
summary: .cache/reads/<safe key>: the folder of key's parts.

name: parts_of
summary: parts.json of key: part name -> file, rows, read_at, statements, colsets, errors, status ok | failed; {} when missing or damaged.

name: clear_parts
summary: Every part of key read again next time (folder removed) under lock(key): a read still running finishes first.

name: parts_read_at
summary: When the oldest part was read (epoch seconds), else None: the time the data is from ("Data from").

name: old
summary: The ACTIVITY / OBJECT_USE rows of the earlier read (of base, else key) a Direct load starts from, kept as old.pkl with the parts so a resumed load asks for the same days and its part names stay the same.

name: engine
summary: What writes and reads parquet: pyarrow, else duckdb, else None (no parts: a load reads everything).

name: duck_type
summary: DuckDB type of one column's Python values (DECIMAL scale, TIMESTAMPTZ when any tz, HUGEINT, ...); a mix of types raises, so that part is not kept.

name: write_part
summary: Rows -> parquet with every column any row of the wave has (pyarrow), else a typed DuckDB table COPY TO; written as .tmp and renamed, so a half-written file never counts.

name: read_part
summary: Parquet -> list of dicts via pyarrow, else duckdb read_parquet.

name: part_name
summary: Readable label + sha1 of the statements (10 hex): other statements (another run, other days) are another part.

name: parted
summary: Wraps query(sql) so every read is kept as a part of key and answered from the parts already kept; q.keep() takes a whole each() wave (one part per heavy read, or one per wave; a wave with timed-out statements reads only those again); q.fresh asks Snowflake without keeping a part (the last OK run); a lost session is never kept; offline (run.py --build) never reaches Snowflake; a USE answered from its part is replayed before the next live statement.

name: COPYING
summary: cache key -> the thread writing its SQL copy (sql_info says "Being written now" while it runs)

name: shared_key
summary: Build key of the shared data set: ("shared", RUN_ID, FINISHED_AT).

name: stages
summary: First load: stage 1 cache.get(KEY, read_shared) (parts from disk, missing ones from Snowflake, .pkl and SQL copy), then stage 2 built(); says "Ready in N s".

name: built
summary: Stage 2 under LOCK: a.step("Building the role graph") a.build(d, shared_key(d)), a count line, then a.step("Checking the rules") a.rule_rows unless kept_rules() put them back; saves them.

name: kept_rules
summary: Shared data only, Snowflake mode, disk allowed: rule results (KEPT keys of a.memo) in .cache/<key>.rules.pkl, valid while (build key, builtin, a.rules_stamp(), SERVER_STAMP) match; restore into a.memo (True) or save.

name: note_info
summary: A NOTES key in plain words (title, meaning, fix); new keys no_run, missing_names, missing_columns, secondary_roles, user, and UNAVAILABLE grants / user_roles.

name: refresh
summary: Rebuild snapshot / Read Snowflake again as one JOB (id, what, state running|done|failed, ok, message); a second one while running is refused; BACKGROUND: renew() in a daemon thread, answer {started, job}; else renew() inline.

name: renew
summary: Under LOAD and tracked(): rebuild in objects mode CALLs call_snapshot() first (not OK -> keep the data, say why); then read_shared(KEY + ".new") (its parts cleared only when older than an hour, so a refresh that failed within the hour resumes), built(), cache.swap(KEY, new, d).

name: call_snapshot
summary: CALL <WHERE>.SP_ACCESS_SNAPSHOT('AUTO'): the JSON outcome as a dict; no row, NULL or other text -> None; an error -> 503 rebuild_failed.

name: quiet_log
summary: uvicorn LOGGING_CONFIG copy whose access handler filters out GET /api/progress (NoProgress).

name: export
summary: run.py --export: stage 1 only, the missing parts of the shared data read (fresh: every part), progress lines on the terminal, nothing built; every part ok -> cache.drop(KEY) so the next start builds from the new parts, exit 0; else 1 (rerun resumes).

name: tracked
summary: fn() inside a.progress(add): lines kept in PROGRESS[key] (last MAX_LINES 200) for GET /api/progress, also printed on the terminal when LOG_LINES; "failed: ..." on an error.

name: NoProgress
summary: logging filter: drops access lines naming /api/progress (the page asks every second during a load)

name: OFFLINE
summary: BUILD_ONLY=1 (run.py --build): built from the parts kept, never a Snowflake read

name: LOG_LINES
summary: progress lines also on the terminal: True under python server.py and in app.py

name: JOB
summary: the last refresh: id, what, state running|done|failed, ok, message (sent as job by /api/progress)

name: BACKGROUND
summary: refresh in a thread (not inside Snowflake; app.py sets False: one call at a time there)

name: KEPT
summary: memo keys kept across restarts: findings, rows, ro, breaks

name: BUILD_ONLY_NOTE
summary: message when a refresh is asked of a --build run

name: dated
summary: Whether v is a day day() reads (None or bad text: False).

name: lost
summary: Whether an error means the session is gone (ConnectionError, OperationalError / InterfaceError, errno 390111/390112/390114): that stops a load; any other error is an unreadable table.

name: progress
summary: Context manager: reads report lines through say() to fn; a heartbeat thread adds "Still working after N min: <running steps>" every BEAT (60) s.

name: say
summary: Send a progress line to the current sink (and remember it as the last line); no-op outside progress().

name: step
summary: Context manager for a build step: "<name>…", the heartbeat names it while it runs, then "<name>: done in N s".

name: use_start
summary: (OBJECT_USE rows to keep, first Monday to read): rows without a week are read again, not an error.

name: hours
summary: An ACTIVITY row's HOURS as {hour 0-23 text: queries}: JSON text parsed, bad text or null -> {}.

name: usable
summary: Whether a row has what the walks need: every NEED column, a day / week that parses, an action READ / WRITE / DDL.

name: tidy
summary: Data set in place in build()'s shape (returns early when d["_tidy"] equals tidy_stamp(); possible_issue, not verified: nothing sets _tidy, so it runs on every uncached build, access.py:1551): run a dict with SOURCES / NOTES; every table a list with every sql/1_setup.sql column; a missing table empty + UNAVAILABLE; rows without names / day / action left out (missing_names); missing snapshot columns noted (missing_columns).

name: below
summary: bfs([role]) once per data set (cached): rules 3 and 14 ask it for the same roles again and again.

name: when
summary: A time as a naive datetime: None for empty / "now" / text that is no time; a date as midnight.

name: lose_key
summary: memo key of lose(e): ("lose",) + the edge's values.

name: rules_stamp
summary: sha1 of access.py plus every environ.get setting it names (also on the next line) and its value: what rule results depend on besides the data.

name: close_ducks
summary: atexit: close every duck() connection before the interpreter tears DuckDB down.

name: duck_table
summary: CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE name from Python rows, one typed list per column UNNESTed side by side.

name: duck
summary: In-memory DuckDB, once per data set: E role links (K grant rows), S start roles per user (+ PUBLIC), RP path counts from one INSERT ... GROUP BY per hop; None without duckdb, with a role loop, past MAX_HOPS or on a DuckDB error (e.g. more than 2^127 paths): the Python walk answers.

name: read_shares
summary: {role: (data objects reached, read only, written or owned, owned, schema CREATE grants reached)} from RP joined with each holder's own grants, once per data set; rules 17 and 23 walk only roles these counts can flag. None without duck().

name: lose_all
summary: lose(e) for many edges at once: role links from one DuckDB query (paths(user, grantee) x K = paths(user, role)); privilege edges as users reaching the grantee and no other holder; a DuckDB error or no duck() leaves them to lose() per edge.

name: COLUMNS
summary: TBL_ACCESS_ tables of sql/1_setup.sql with DuckDB column types (moved from cache.py; tidy() fills every column, test_duckdb checks them)

name: BEAT
summary: seconds between the heartbeat lines of a long load (60)

name: NEED
summary: per table the columns a row must have, else tidy() leaves it out

name: SRC
summary: per table its SOURCES / NOTES key (GRANT -> grants, ...)

name: DUCKS
summary: WeakSet of the duck() connections alive: a dropped data set's goes with it, the rest closed at exit

name: command
summary: (cmd, env) to start the app: app web|streamlit, --fake (FAKE=1), --direct / --objects (SOURCE), --port; --export [--fresh] -> python server.py --export (stage 1 only, exit); --build -> BUILD_ONLY=1 (built from the parts, never Snowflake); --fresh without --export is an error.

name: App
summary: Router shell: VIEWS page map, top bar, side nav, LoadLog; a refresh started in the background (reload answers started + job) shows a top-bar indicator with the latest line and polls /api/progress until JOB ends, then clears the cache and shows the outcome; the first load and a 409 shared_loading make the page inert; SQL buttons and right-click SQL only once data is loaded (end line approximate).

name: tidy_stamp
summary: First 12 hex of cached_stamp(): a data set tidied by older code is tidied again.

name: cached_stamp
summary: sha1 of access.py, computed once (functools.cache).

name: SERVER_STAMP
summary: sha1 of server.py: part of the kept rule results' stamp (breaks() lives here)
